worst_problem: Key story props and staging logic are broken across the scene: the weeping couple in b077 is on the wrong side of the street with no jewel in the man's hands, the dellal in b079 jams an empty hand into his own mouth instead of dangling the bracelets high, Zoubida and Fatma stand between the father and the dellal during the hand-to-hand transfer in b080, and the crowd is completely missing in b082 when the dellal's hand with the bracelets should travel above the heads.
